steps.label: COEXISTENCE / CENTRALIZED
steps.sub: synced both ways, or one hub owns writes

eyebrow: Coexistence vs. centralized — who writes first
code:
COEXISTENCE:   source system writes -> syncs to hub
               hub correction -> syncs back to source

CENTRALIZED:   every write happens at the hub FIRST
               source systems only read from the hub
caption: The spectrum is really about who gives up independent writes, and when.
